title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Named variant classes with a diagnostic feature and exception
summary: A Pliny fruit passage supplies a content system in which one named whole is split into variants by independently stated shape, colour, taste, origin or ripening features, with an explicit preparation exception. On an admitted Herbal line this predicts mutually exclusive feature slots and a marked exception, beyond whole-form recurrence.

design.mechanism: A descriptive natural-history register first identifies a parent whole, then assigns one feature-defined variant; an exception changes the allowed preservation or use relation. The feature is content, not an assumed spelling class.
design.external_primary: Pliny, Natural History XV, fruit-tree varieties and preservation, Perseus: https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/text?doc=Perseus%3Aabo%3Aphi%2C0978%2C001%3A15
design.source_example: The passage distinguishes named apples by colour, resemblance, shape, origin, flavour, ripening speed and seed absence; it then says apples and pears are stored like grapes, with a named fruit exception in the preservation claim. These are feature and exception relations, not synonyms.
design.target_endpoint: The already admitted complete Herbal surface f17r.5 in GDT625/GDT768: `ychekchy cthy chor shor cphor cphaldy dair cthey qody`, plus the already admitted f29v.1 complete prefix containing `kooiin shor chetchy ... cthy ...`.
design.reading_a: A feature-taxonomy record: one parent material or plant class is followed by mutually exclusive variant/part descriptors, and one exceptional descriptor licenses a different use or preservation relation.
design.reading_b: A flat part-and-state inventory: adjacent nominal fields are co-present components or preparation states; no field excludes another and no exceptional relation changes the record's legal continuation.
design.observable_difference: Freeze complete entries and independently code feature contrasts before assigning meanings. Reading A predicts that a parent/variant frame carries one selected feature slot, that incompatible feature values do not co-occur within that slot, and that the exceptional frame is the only one with a changed downstream use/result. Reading B permits co-occurring part/state fields without an exclusivity or exception transition. A repeated form by itself is not evidence.
design.smallest_test: Within already admitted complete Herbal entries, identify a source-independent parent/variant boundary and test one held feature contrast plus one held exception-to-use consequence. Stop if the supposed feature and exception labels are inherited from guessed glosses.
design.nearest_rival: The parallel part-list reading in GDT625/GDT768.
assumption_costs: Pliny's feature-and-exception architecture is a historical analogue, not a Voynich key.
Target parent, variant, feature and use slots must be independently observable.
The exception cannot be inferred from a line end or an arbitrary rare form.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The admitted f17r.5 line has several adjacent part-like fields but no independent feature or exception marker, leaving taxonomy and inventory observationally equivalent.
